label: Free, every Tuesday
title: The Draft.
lead: Every Tuesday, one thing that actually worked on LinkedIn. The post, the numbers behind it, and what I would change if I wrote it again.
proof: I ship more than 750 posts a year for B2B founders and executives. Everything in here is tested there first, and I show you the numbers either way.
formLead: Subscribe and the first thing in your inbox is ten of the best performing posts from the 21 B2B accounts I run, pulled apart line by line, with the real impressions and follower numbers attached.
disclosure: One letter a week. Leave whenever you like, no hard feelings.
issuesNote: Open any of them. It will ask for your email part way down, which is the trade: the rest of that issue, and a new one every Tuesday.
